settings.title: Smart Payment Plans That Do Not Strain Your Budget

settings.editor:
A major HVAC project can feel overwhelming when the cost comes all at once. Financing gives you room to plan, compare options, and choose the right solution for your home without draining savings in a single payment.

Newman Air offers financing through:

  • GoodLeap
  • Synchrony
  • Hearth

With approved credit, financing may help you:

  • Spread project costs over time
  • Move forward with urgent repairs or replacements sooner
  • Upgrade aging equipment before it fails completely
  • Choose a higher-efficiency comfort system when it makes sense
  • Plan around monthly payments
  • Protect your budget during unexpected HVAC emergencies

Financing terms, approval, payment options, and promotional plans vary by provider. Our team can walk you through the available options so you know what to expect before making a decision.

settings.title: What HVAC Services Can Financing Help Cover?

settings.editor: Financing may be available for many types of HVAC work. Whether you are planning ahead or dealing with an unexpected breakdown, Newman Air can help you understand which options may apply to your project.
Do not hibernate in a hot home. Financing may help with major AC repairs, central AC replacement, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump installation, or other cooling upgrades.
When East Tennessee cold nights settle in, your heating system needs to be ready. Financing may help cover furnace replacement, heat pump installation, major heating repairs, or system upgrades.
True comfort is about more than temperature. Financing may be available for whole-home air quality solutions, including air cleaners, air handlers, germicidal lights, and related HVAC improvements.
If your comfort issues are tied to airflow, ductwork, or uneven rooms, financing may help make larger improvements more manageable.

settings.title: Why Financing Can Be a Smart Choice

settings.editor:
Financing is not about spending more than you need. It is about giving you flexibility when your home comfort cannot wait.

It may be a smart option if:

  • Your HVAC system breaks down unexpectedly
  • A repair cost is higher than expected
  • Replacement makes more sense than repeated repairs
  • You want to upgrade before peak heating or cooling season
  • Your home needs ductwork or indoor air quality improvements
  • You want to protect savings while still addressing the problem

Our goal is to give you clear information, not pressure. We will explain your service options, discuss financing availability, and help you decide what fits your home and budget.

Choosing financing is only part of the decision. You also need an HVAC team that gives honest guidance, does clean work, and treats your home with respect.

settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions About HVAC Financing

settings.html: Still wondering about something?Call (423) 753-7788

Who does Newman Air partner with for financing?

Newman Air offers financing options through GoodLeap, Synchrony, and Hearth. Each provider may offer different payment options, terms, approval requirements, and promotional plans.

Can I apply for Hearth financing online?

Yes. Newman Air can add an Apply for Financing button that links directly to the company’s Hearth application page. This will take customers to an external Hearth site to complete the application.

What HVAC services can I finance?

Financing may be available for many HVAC services, including AC replacement, heating replacement, major repairs, ductwork, indoor air quality upgrades, heat pumps, and full system installations. Availability depends on the project and financing provider.

Is financing only for emergency HVAC repairs?

No. Financing can help with both urgent repairs and planned upgrades. Some homeowners use financing when a system fails unexpectedly, while others use it to plan ahead for replacement or efficiency improvements.

Will I know my payment options before moving forward?

In most cases, approved applicants can review available payment options before moving forward. Terms and approval depend on the financing provider.

Does applying for financing guarantee approval?

No. Financing is subject to credit approval and provider terms. Rates, payment options, promotional plans, and approval may vary.

Can financing help with indoor air quality upgrades?

Yes, financing may be available for indoor air quality projects such as air cleaners, germicidal lights, air handler work, and related HVAC improvements. Newman Air can confirm which options may apply to your project.
